TickrAlert
Set stock alerts and get instant email or SMS notifications
TickrAlert lets active investors set custom alerts for stocks, ETFs, and major indices and receive notifications the moment conditions are met. You can choose price targets, percentage moves, volume spikes, or breakout levels and get alerted by email or SMS without watching charts all day. TickrAlert checks markets continuously during trading hours and offers a free tier for basic price alerts, with paid plans unlocking momentum, volume, and breakout alerts so you never miss a move.

The Final Tape
Audit your trades with AI to find and fix costly mistakes
The Final Tape is a trading journal and performance analysis platform that turns your trade history into actionable forensics. Its AI Council, made up of eight specialized agents, reconstructs completed trades, debates findings, and delivers a ranked Kill List of fixes quantified by preventable monthly dollars. Traders use modules like Trading Floor, Monte Carlo, Exit Oracle, and Quant Lab to review execution, psychology, risk, and setups, then follow a step-by-step plan to recover their edge with data-backed decisions.

AI-native, privacy-first task management that understands natural typing

It works fully offline, syncs across iOS, Android, and web, and is Swiss-made and privacy-first. The team is also building toward Task Decay: an AI that clears tasks once they stop mattering.

AI campaign analytics for your links
Most link shorteners only give you a click count. trimy.io provides a verdict.
trimy.io is an AI-powered link analytics platform that offers short links, QR codes, UTM tracking, and link-in-bio pages. It actively analyzes performance with a Campaign Health Score (0-100) and tips to improve, an A/B Test Interpreter that explains which variant won and why, analytics narratives in plain English, and an AI chat that answers questions about your click data.
It is built for SMB marketing teams and agencies running multiple client campaigns. The free plan includes 30 links per month, 1 custom domain, and AI analysis with no credit card required.

Modaal
Cross-platform native AI app builder for iOS and Android
Modaal is a cross-platform native AI app builder that lets product people build and ship real iOS and Android apps with their own AI agent. Instead of one React Native codebase drawing the same screens on both phones, Modaal shares the logic, not the screens. Your agent writes real Swift for iPhone and real Kotlin for Android from one project, based on a plan you approve before any code is written. This lets first-time founders or product teams take an idea to both stores with no credit meters or rebuilds.
